description: This file generates a changelog from commit data, categorizing changes based on labels and formatting the output with credits.
external_files: pull request data from GitHub API

methods.name: getCommitPullRequest
methods.description: Fetches pull request data associated with a commit using GitHub API.

methods.name: getSectionForPullRequest
methods.description: Determines the section category for a pull request based on its labels.

methods.name: groupByLabels
methods.description: Groups commits into sections based on their associated pull request labels.

methods.name: cleanupPRTitle
methods.description: Removes '[Docs] ' prefix from PR titles for cleaner display.

methods.name: buildChangelog
methods.description: Constructs the changelog text from grouped sections and authors.
